the_single_source: The ClickUp list 🤖 Agent Index — https://app.clickup.com/36074068/v/li/901328043244 — is THE canonical resolution index for every agent. One task per agent. Resolve a token by querying that list for the row, not by reading a file.
how_to_resolve_now: Query the Agent Index list for the ONE row you need (match on task name, the Slug field, or the AKA field) and read its fields: Slug · Class · Memory · Invoke · AKA · Home · Lane · default_runbook · Gate Strength · Instructions. Then load that agent's bundle from `home`, which is still a git path. Full contract: gates/agent-invocation-gate.md STEP 0.
why_it_was_retired: It was a 39-record TABLE being simulated by a text file that had to be read WHOLE on every resolution, with no range read. That forced a ~12KB size ceiling which the file NEVER ONCE met in its entire life: 24.8KB → 14.4 → 21.1 → 18.4 → 13.18 → 13.67. Six trim actions across five commits in four days (PR #483, 5c3a8cc, 66fdb06, 78d1c92 ×2, PR #559), and it regrew +6.7KB in a single day under normal fleet work. Trimming a document does not hold, because a document has an unbounded free-text area and no schema to refuse an essay. A list has fields. Michael, 2026-07-30: 'it's a table. not a doc.'
the_failure_this_prevents: At ~25KB this file could not be read back whole, which is how Dev Dexter shipped BUILT-BUT-UNREGISTERED on 2026-07-25. A file that cannot be read whole cannot be safely edited, and the roster IS the registration surface. The ceiling was not tidiness; it was the bug.

where_each_part_went.agents[] rows: → one task per agent in the Agent Index list. Fields carry identity; the bundle carries the role.
where_each_part_went.invocation.tokens: → the Invoke + AKA fields on each row. The collision WARNINGS that lived alongside them (Clio/Cleo homophones, Rocky→Ricky, Dex/Dara, the immutable fmp-frank slug, Wes never resolving to the tombstone) are RULES, and they live in gates/agent-invocation-gate.md (read side) + gates/agent-name-collision-gate.md (write side), which already held them. This file was the second copy.
where_each_part_went.pointers: → already duplicated in gates/git-agent-authoring.md + the lifecycle runbook. Not migrated; it died here.
where_each_part_went._, this_is_an_INDEX, where_the_descripti: → DELETED, deliberately. Self-describing schema commentary is exactly the prose that colonized this file six times. A list's field set IS its schema and needs no essay explaining itself.

A JSON roster alongside the ClickUp list would be the exact mirror-pair rot both retirements exist to kill. There is ONE index and it is the list.
